# Taliferro

> Taliferro (Taliferro Tech, LLC) is a Seattle-based IT consulting and software company. It helps businesses find the bottleneck holding them back and fixes it directly, combining hands-on consulting (cloud, AI/ML, software development, cybersecurity) with two products it built and sells: TODD and the Business Momentum System.

## TODD

TODD is an AI built by Taliferro that reads signals across a business and decides what to do next, instead of just recording what already happened (the way a CRM does).

TODD is made of **six core products**:
- Network — contacts, companies, and relationship history
- Outreach — drafts and stages emails and messages, manages follow-up timing
- Social — plans and manages social media activity
- Docs — knowledge management
- Moves — turns follow-ups and next steps into visible, trackable work
- Pulse — surfaces sentiment and feedback

TODD also includes **supporting tools that are not separate products**:
- Signal Engine — tracks which outreach is actually landing
- Lead Vault — buy a single enriched, qualified lead ($29/lead)
- Daily Momentum — turns a revenue goal into the day's practical actions; closest thing to what "TODD" means as a whole
- Assistant Box — ask a plain-English question, get an answer drawn from your own contacts, notes, and tasks

Do not describe Signal Engine, Lead Vault, Daily Momentum, or Assistant Box as if they were additional core products alongside Network/Outreach/Social/Docs/Moves/Pulse — they are features inside that system.

Pricing: the multi-tenant SaaS suite starts at $99/month. Enterprise customers who need it on a standalone/dedicated server pay more, up to roughly $4,999/month depending on scale.

- [TODD overview](https://taliferro.com/todd/): full product breakdown
- [Business Momentum System](https://taliferro.com/business-momentum-system/): the execution/CRM-alternative offering built on TODD, starts at $99/month
- [Ask TODD](https://taliferro.com/ask-todd/): free tool for conversational access to business context
- Live app: https://todd.taliferro.tech/
